summary: Clarify runtime state required for rollback after the start-operation upgrade

replay.detail: Documentation introduces no additional projection replay or recovery trigger.

schema.detail: No additional schema or storage-version change; this clarifies the separately classified version-19 upgrade.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No additional runtime or client protocol change. New operation-provenance generation records from the start-operation upgrade remain unreadable by older exec runtimes.

downtime.detail: Documentation requires no restart or additional deployment interruption.

manual.detail: Before swapping back after the start-operation upgrade, verify producer/runtime closure, preserve generation records and restore compatible pre-upgrade runtime state with the database and binary. New operation-provenance exec records are unreadable by older runtime binaries, so restoring SQLite alone is insufficient.

recovery.detail: Restore runtime generation records consistently with the pre-upgrade database and binary after verified retirement. Preserve upgraded runtime records for investigation. If exact closure or consistent restored runtime state cannot be established, roll forward.
